Completion evidence

Validation records

- D1 passed. python scripts/gen_cli_help.py --check reported current generated help.
- D2 passed. python scripts/gen_cli_reference.py --check reported a current CLI reference.
- D3 passed with 36 tests. The focused help generator and registry contracts passed.
- D4 passed with 221 tests. Public help, nested ownership, no-write behavior, and lifecycle contracts passed.
- D5 passed. make lint and make typecheck passed across 640 files.
- D6 passed with 53 tests. Compatibility vocabulary and output schema contracts passed.
- Nine restored held-out cases passed through D3 and D4.
- [operator-attested] Gerrit Verified run 32624707092 exercised commit 131e75a16d88b26c02a715e213bd95f51b9d4b89 across the gating matrix. Outcome: success.

Acceptance criteria

- [x] Every live visible route outside the documented omit set appears exactly once in overview help. Proof: D1, D3, and D4 passed.
- [x] rebar help <command> succeeds for every canonical pure-intercept route returned by the registry. Proof: D3, D4, and the held-out cases passed.
- [x] The pure-intercept help contract proves that no command handler executes. Proof: D4 passed test_create_help_no_write_b8de.py.
- [x] The pure-intercept help contract proves that no ticket store is mounted or created. Proof: D4 passed the no-write and central mount contracts.
- [x] rebar help <command> returns the matching committed artifact bytes. Proof: D3, D4, and the held-out byte comparisons passed.
- [x] Top-level rebar <command> --help returns the matching committed artifact bytes. Proof: D3, D4, and the held-out byte comparisons passed.
- [x] Every pure-intercept parser factory supplies a nonblank overview description. Proof: D3 passed the generator census.
- [x] The committed trusted-env usage banner preserves separate add and revoke lines. Proof: D3 passed the pinned artifact contract.
- [x] Each CLI-reference pure-intercept syntax block equals the matching committed artifact. Proof: D2 and D3 passed.
- [x] A repository-wide semantic and string search reports zero _render_intercept references. Proof: D3 passed the removal contract and the merged tree contains no symbol reference.
- [x] All four help-backed census sites use the live-visible predicate. Proof: D3 and D4 passed the registry census contracts.
- [x] The exact overview exemptions remain help, bridge-fsck, and bridge-probe. Proof: D3 and D4 passed the exact-set assertion.
- [x] Hidden aliases and retired spellings remain absent from overview discovery. Proof: D4 passed the visibility controls.
- [x] _NESTED_INTERCEPTS equals audit, config, identity, llm, prompt, criteria, and workflow. Proof: D4 passed the exact-set assertion.
- [x] Every parser-introspectable nested family returns child-parser usage for each child. Proof: D4 passed the nested-family census.
- [x] The identity create, identity use, and identity key help paths return child usage and exit successfully. Proof: D4 and the held-out cases passed.
- [x] The config validate help path reaches build_validate and returns validate child help. Proof: D4 passed the explicit control.
- [x] Comments and test docstrings describe committed help ownership accurately. Proof: D3, D4, and lint passed on the merged source.
- [x] The help drift check passes on supported Python versions. Proof: Gerrit Verified run 32624707092 passed Python 3.11, 3.12, and 3.13 jobs.
- [x] The CLI-reference drift check passes. Proof: D2 and Gerrit Verified run 32624707092 passed.
- [x] No competing routing, parser, or help mechanism is introduced. Proof: The merged change extends the route registry and existing generators. LLM-Review passed at +1.
- [x] No mechanical writing enforcement is introduced. Proof: The merged file set contains no writing-policy gate.
- [x] The Markdown-only reduced test policy remains unchanged. Proof: The merged change does not modify that policy or its route classifier.
- [x] Retained compatibility spellings are categorized without removing them from generated help. Proof: D6 passed and jira-onboard remains generated.
- [x] Every newly discovered output advertiser has a registered schema. Proof: D6 passed schema coverage for config, scan-spec, and sign-review.
- [x] Offline output advertisers are exercised against their registered schemas. Proof: D6 passed the config and sign-review drivers.
- [x] Every model-backed driver exemption has a nonblank reason. Proof: D6 passed the reason and stale-entry guards.
- [x] The fixture-store contract test does not invoke model-backed output advertisers. Proof: D6 passed with the four model operations exempted from offline execution.
- [x] The three CI regressions reproduce red before remediation and pass afterward. Proof: Run 32620281081 reproduced all three failures across four matrix jobs. D6 and run 32624707092 passed after remediation.

Gerrit change 2148 merged as 131e75a16d88b26c02a715e213bd95f51b9d4b89. LLM-Review is +1, Verified is +1, and the unresolved comment count is zero.
